about.label: 01 / About
about.title: A developer who cares about *how it feels* to use the web.
paragraphs: I’m Aimee, a front-end developer with an eye for clean interfaces and a practical, people-first approach to building them. I enjoy the space where thoughtful design and well-crafted code meet.
Whether I’m shaping a responsive component system or refining a tiny interaction, I’m always asking: is this clear, useful and welcoming for everyone?
